approaches.hypothesis: When a long task hides diagnostic text beyond the encoder character bound, independently embed the failure and append distinct admitted hits after the incumbent ranking.
approaches.selection: Reject on any delivered-answer loss, worse delivered rank, extra returned record on any negative, scope leak or packet overflow.

approaches.hypothesis: After ordinary lexical and file pools are empty, split ASCII CamelCase/PascalCase/acronym boundaries and require every component as exact FTS terms. Reject names with generic or short components; bound to four names of at most eight components.
approaches.selection: Must improve lexical delivery on development and heldout with no per-case guard failures, and preserve incumbent hybrid delivery, rank and abstention.

regression_guards: All 258 existing cases under lexical and hybrid policies; preserve delivered answers and their ranks, never increase negative returned counts, enforce scope and token budget.
Frozen diagnostic and identifier cases use the same guards. Select on development, then evaluate only accepted approaches on heldout.
No new aliases, source claim edits, threshold retuning, model weights or model release.
novelty: Prior work tried word/concept/character embeddings, document order, thresholds, reranking, packing and index completion. These trials change structured query decomposition and diagnostic-channel availability.
